Questions: parquet subset 16_frame. Frames: official pre-sampled video.zip:16_frame/<scene>.mp4 (exactly 16 frames). Paper Table 13 (no Room Size / Route Plan; Qwen3-VL-8B 43.7, 32B 46.2 Avg).
_frames: ReVSI.build_prompt sends the raw 16-frame mp4 as a video message without sampling keys; the client samples with model-level nframes=16 (video_sampling below), and qwen-vl-utils linspace(0,15,16) on a 16-frame video is the identity, so all 16 official frames are sent (scripts/check_revsi_frames.py; scripts/check_video_sampling.py). Dataset nframe=16 is the non-VIDEO_LLM path (all 16 frames as images) and is enforced by the class.
